message.subject: Outdoor durability claims—quick idea
message.body:
Hi [Name],

I saw Nazdar at PRINTING United and ISA Sign Expo recently, and your focus on outdoor durability really stood out.

Many ink suppliers we work with struggle to differentiate on performance claims alone. We've helped several companies turn their standard outdoor warranties into significantly extended guarantees by pairing their inks with our protective overlaminate—which has opened up premium fleet graphics and architectural segments they couldn't compete in before.

Given your positioning and upcoming trade show calendar, this might be worth a quick conversation. Would it help if I sent over a few examples of how other companies have used this for competitive differentiation?

Best,
[Your name]

personalization_used.hook: Nazdar's trade show presence and outdoor durability positioning create opportunity for differentiation in competitive ink supplier landscape
personalization_used.value_prop_emphasized: Extended outdoor durability enables premium market positioning and competitive advantage in fleet graphics and architectural segments
